mechanism: From open positions build signed nominal exposures; time-align H1 log returns via master-clock iBarShift; estimate sample covariance Σ; naive risk = sqrt(diag-only w' diag(Σ) w) scaled to daily (×z≈1.645); true risk = sqrt(w'Σw); hidden factor = 100×true/naive. Alert when hidden≥130%, true risk≥3% equity, or top contributor share≥50%.
data_needed: Open positions (symbol, volume, side); CopyTime/iClose per symbol on CorrTimeframe (default H1) Lookback≈200; tick value/size for money exposure.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Live multi-asset book example BTCUSD, US500, EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100; H1 correlations, daily risk scaling
why_new_for_mis: Turns pairwise correlation into a live account-level stacking/hedge sensor (hidden factor + concentration) MIS can watch as a portfolio regime of diversification failure, not just per-symbol vol.
quote: Hidden factor: your real risk is 156% of the naive number.

Conservative/neutral → expect bounce; aggressive → expect breakout-pullback path. Gate with ATR×0.5 proximity, HTF EMA+RSI exhaustion, pin/engulf confirm.

mechanism: Weekend gap = Monday open − Friday close in pips (≥48h bar gap); fill = post-open M5 touch of Friday close (direction-aware) within inpFillTimeLimit (default 168h); NO_DATA excluded. Python: fill rate by pip buckets, Logit P(fill)~gap_pips, Kaplan–Meier time-to-fill. Sample: ~78.7% fill, median 1h, size β insignificant (p≈0.50) in 2–67 pips.
data_needed: H1 (or gap TF) bars; M5 fill scan; pip size from digits; CSV schema close_time,open_time,gap_pips,gap_filled,fill_time_hours.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD,GBPUSD,USDJPY (also majors/minors/indices/commodities/crypto lists); gap H1, fill M5; window ≤168h
why_new_for_mis: Operational calendar discontinuity sensor: gap size + censored fill clock + survival curve—MIS can score Monday open liquidity-recovery likelihood and horizon without assuming size alone predicts fill.
quote: Among the gaps that filled, approximately 55% did so within the first hour, 67% within 4 hours, and over 90% within 24 hours.

mechanism: FSM WAIT_CROSS→WAIT_MOMENTUM→WAIT_RETRACEMENT→ORDER: MA cross sets direction only; within ≤2 bars require body≥MomentumBodyMinPips in direction; immediate next bar must pass RetracementMode (lower-high/higher-low and/or inside); else reset. Pending stop at retrace edge; SL beyond momentum extreme.

quote: Moving average crossovers provide direction, but immediate entries are vulnerable to whipsaws when the price lacks follow-through.

mechanism: CEgarchProcess models ln(σ²_t)=ω+α(|z|-E|z|)+γ z+β ln(σ²_{t-1}) so parameters may be negative; grid-search starts; stationarity via β sum<1; recursion + simulation multi-step forecasts. Model-free leverage pre-tests: Corr(r_t,r²_{t+lag}), VolatilityRuns χ², Engle–Ng sign/size bias on residuals.
data_needed: Return vector (scaled); p,o,q orders; optional GARCH residuals for Engle–Ng; confidence level.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo returns dataset; TestsForAsymmetry on US30Cash D1 and XAUUSD D1 (2000 bars from 2026.01.01)
why_new_for_mis: Adds unconstrained asymmetric conditional-vol sensing plus model-free leverage diagnostics so MIS can detect sign-dependent vol response before choosing an asymmetric vol model.
quote: By modeling the natural logarithm of conditional variance rather than the raw variance itself, Nelson ensured that predicted volatility remained positive without imposing non-negativity constraints

mechanism: Fit rolling EGARCH; take standardized residuals; AVRO = mean(fast window stdresid) − mean(slow window stdresid). Negative/falling AVRO maps accelerating downside + panic variance expansion; rising positive AVRO maps positive shocks suppressing variance. Also EIZ = (latest z − window mean)/window std as strain sensor.
data_needed: Rolling HistoryLen returns; FastWindowLen/SlowWindowLen; EGARCH fit outputs std_resid.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Indicator on chart symbols with sufficient history (library demo data SPY2017.csv; equity/FX examples in tests)
why_new_for_mis: Turns EGARCH leverage/innovation path into an explicit calm↔panic regime oscillator and innovation z-score—MIS can sense asymmetric vol-state transitions, not only σ̂_t level.
quote: The Asymmetric Volatility Regime Oscillator (AVRO) tracks directional trend strength by monitoring the speed at which variance transitions between a calm state and a panic state.

mechanism: Python solves ATM call/put IV from GLD option mid prices (Black–Scholes bisection), interpolates to 30d in total variance; MQL5 computes 30-session annualized RV on XAUUSD D1; ratio=IV/RV classifies REGIME_EXPENSIVE≥1.20, PREMIUM≥1.05, INLINE≥0.95, else UNDERPRICED; service alerts on regime change with feed-age staleness.

instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GLD options proxy; XAUUSD D1 RV; 30-day horizon; feed poll ~15 min

quote: I prefer the ratio, implied divided by realized, because it's scale-free and survives regime changes in a way that raw volatility points don't.
